summary: Unknown-total Progress tasks are implemented. A task with total=None renders as a pulsing bar with blank percentage and time-remaining columns, and "?" placeholders in the count and download columns. Changes are in rich/progress.py, rich/progress_bar.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and tests/test_progress.py; nothing is committed. tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_bar.py pass (52 passed). Full-suite run: 13 failures in card, markdown, syntax and traceback tests fail identically on the original code, so they predate this change. tests/test_pretty.py cannot be collected because the shared venv lacks the attr module; I did not install packages. Black is not in the venv, so formatting was not checked by tool.
